notes: ‘Bees’ in general (solitary bees, ‘many bees build … combs’, Buffon’s ‘abeilles’). Resolved to the bee clade Anthophila: NCBI 3042114 (clade; NOT 999306, the choreutid moth genus Anthophila) and Wikidata Q7391. The GBIF backbone has no bee clade; its exact match for ‘Anthophila’ (5123443) is the moth genus and is deliberately not used, so gbif_usage_key is null.
